title: zl.iter
description: split a list into lists of a given size

messages.description: performs the operation again on the last received list
size of the lists to output
successive lists of the given size

arguments.description: size of the lists to output, minimum 1

methods.description: clears the mode's arguments and the data received in both inlets
sets the maximum list size, 1 to 32767

body: [zl.iter] breaks a list into successive lists of a given size; a shorter last part is output too. The argument or the right inlet sets the size, which is at least 1; the default 0 does nothing.
